evals.prompt: Save a private memo in Memos with content 'Picked up milk #errand #today', then attach a new attachment without removing existing attachments on another memo memos/abc123.
evals.expected_output: Calls memo_create_memo with body.content and visibility PRIVATE, and for memos/abc123 calls memo_list_memo_attachments first before memo_set_memo_attachments so existing attachments are preserved.
assertions: Wraps memo_create_memo payload fields inside a body object
Notes memo_set_memo_attachments replaces the entire attachment set on the memo

evals.prompt: Find my saved filter views in Memos and list matching memos, then update memos/xyz789 to pin it.
evals.expected_output: Calls auth_get_current_user and user_list_memo_views to retrieve CEL filters, passes the filter to memo_list_memos, and calls memo_update_memo with top-level name memos/xyz789 and body.pinned: true (omitting name from body).
assertions: Uses auth_get_current_user and/or user_list_memo_views before memo_list_memos
Calls memo_update_memo with top-level name and a non-empty body object (without name inside body)

evals.prompt: Remove the junk tag #212 from all memos in Memos, and explain what happens if I delete a space.
evals.expected_output: Explains Memos has no standalone tag-delete tool because tags come from #hashtags in memo content (so use memo_list_memos + memo_update_memo to edit content), and notes space_delete_space also deletes every memo placed in that space.
assertions: Explains tags are inline #hashtags in content and must be removed by updating memo content via memo_list_memos and memo_update_memo
Warns that space_delete_space deletes every memo placed in the space
